thought.text: I found that SkiaSharp is missing the `libfontconfig.so.1` dependency, so I'm installing it now.

reasoning_content: The server crashed because it can't find the fontconfig library that SkiaSharp depends on. I need to install `libfontconfig1` to resolve this, and possibly `libsqlite3-0` as well, then try running the server again.
